criteria.text: `apps/electron/src/main.mjs`: add an IPC handler that calls `dialog.showOpenDialog({ properties: ['openDirectory'] })` and returns the selected path (or null on cancel).
criteria.test_id: directory-picker: owned native dialog returns only the first path string or null

criteria.text: `apps/electron/src/preload.cjs`: expose one narrow `selectDirectory()` method via `contextBridge` — no broader filesystem surface.
criteria.test_id: directory-picker: actual preload adds only a no-payload selectDirectory capability

criteria.text: `apps/web/src/components/SessionRail.tsx`: enable "Browse…" whenever `window.electron?.selectDirectory` (or equivalent) is present, call it, and fill the `cwd` field with the result. Keep manual path entry as the fallback when the API is absent (e.g. running in a plain browser) — do not remove it.
criteria.test_id: native directory picker is enabled with live history and updates cwd through a click

criteria.text: Add security-test coverage for the new IPC surface (the repo already has an IPC/security-smoke pattern in `apps/electron/src/security-smoke-receipt.mjs` and related tests) — assert the exposed API is scoped to this one method and returns only a path string, no arbitrary filesystem access.
criteria.test_id: signed security smoke accepts the exact hardened bridge and denial receipt
